# Pinned development checkers

These are unmodified canonical ROLES/PITFALL Python checkers and upstream license
notices at the revisions in [pins.json](pins.json). Tig's validator verifies their
hashes before execution. They are development dependencies, not Tig production
scripts or a Python runtime requirement for future Rust tooling.

ROLES software is MIT under its upstream split notice; only its software checker
and notice are copied. PITFALL uses MIT. Neither copy includes private doctrine,
data or credentials. Preserve notices and review source updates explicitly.
